questions.prompt: The same setting is defined on the command line, in the local repo config and in the global config. Which one wins?
questions.explanation: Git reads settings in this order: command-line arguments, environment variables, local repo config, global config, system config. The first one found wins.

questions.prompt: What does `git config user.name "Office Name"` (without `--global`) change?
options: The identity for every repository on the machine
The identity for the current repository only
questions.explanation: Without `--global` the setting is **local**: it applies only to one repository. Global config applies to all repositories on your machine.

questions.prompt: Which command makes `git st` run `git status`?
questions.explanation: Aliases are config entries: `git config --global alias.st status` (and `alias.br branch` for `git br`).
